messages:
samir: Heads-up — onboarding for a new svc-acct in tenant `acme-corp` started failing right after yesterday's KMS key rotation. JIT SAML assertion flow returns 500 and SCIM provisioning gets a 403 for the same externalId. Anyone seen a KMS envelope id mismatch + RBAC role rename recently? @eng-oncall :eyes:
maya: saw the alert around 03:12 UTC. I grabbed the logs, looks like decrypt failing inside the idp service when processing the assertion.
maya: log snippet:
```
2024-11-09T03:12:02Z idp-service ERROR decrypt_jwe failed envelope_id=env_abc123 error="JWE decryption failed: invalid authentication tag"
2024-11-09T03:12:02Z idp-service WARN user_lookup externalId=svc-acct-42 returned=403 reason="provisioning-disabled"
```
alice: hmm provisioning-disabled is interesting — we recently trimmed the "svc-operator" RBAC role and renamed it to "svc-provisioner" in the last infra deploy (PR #832). Could be a role name mismatch in the SCIM mapper.
samir: good catch. KMS error + RBAC rename together could make the idp path bail early and surface 500 then SCIM shows 403. Is the KMS rotate partial (some replicas still have old key)?
eng-oncall: rotation completed, but we had a couple of failed rewrap jobs against replica us-east-2-3. Ops retried them at 02:50 UTC. I'll paste rewrap status.
eng-oncall: rewrap status: env_abc123 -> key:v2 rewrap_state=partial_retry
alice: if envelope_id is now wrapped with key:v2 but the idp pods have cached keystore with key:v1 for a short window, that would produce the JWE decryption auth tag error. Also SCIM mapper may be checking old role name and returning "provisioning-disabled".
maya: can someone check the SCIM role-to-attribute mapping config? I remember we dropped the fallback mapping on the last rollout.
alice: confirmed — config at /etc/idp/config/scim_mappers.yaml on the canary has only "svc-provisioner" mapping. The DB still contains entries referencing "svc-operator" for some tenants (including acme-corp).
samir: steps I'm going to take: 1) coordinate a short canary restart to pick up rewrapped keys, 2) backfill scim mapper fallback for the next 24h, 3) run a targeted re-provision for the tenant. Any objections?
alice: +1, prioritize minimal blast radius. Add a quick check to audit logs to find any other tenants with mixed role names.
maya: I ran a quick query, found ~7 tenants with extIds mapped to the old role. I'll share list in a DM.
idp-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-4287, severity=low-medium, owner=alice, mitigation_window=2h. Audit link: https://console.redwood/inbox/INC-2024-4287
samir: Is there any security concern here (vuln surface) or just provisioning mishap?
alice: low risk. Attack would require a valid signed SAML assertion plus KMS compromise to craft a JWE with a bad tag — not practical. Primary impact is availability and incorrect provisioning.
eng-oncall: I'll patch canary now and watch logs for decryption errors. If we see >5% error rate revert key rotation on the affected replica set.
maya: I'll prepare a short audit log query to surface any 403 provisioning-disabled spikes and send to product security.
samir: thanks. I'll follow up after canary restart and re-provision job completes. :thumbsup:
